scope: CPU numerical and topology evidence for one captured Rain phase; no production GPU implementation or physical qualification.
protocol: Derive bilateral articulation ownership from dynamic-body support of the captured corrected Jacobians. Fixed bodies never join dynamic components. Every bilateral block must belong to one component. Check all off-component entries of Hff are exactly zero before factorization; deliberately injecting a cross-component entry must be rejected. Factor each component independently. Compare against the existing global Cholesky for 24 seeded random reduced states and both independently verified reference endpoints. Float64 equivalence: normalized eliminated-row residual and full recovered velocity difference <=1e-9. Float32 screen: normalized eliminated-row residual and recovered velocity difference <=1e-5. Test two predetermined algebraically equivalent implementations: unscaled float32 Cholesky and symmetric diagonal equilibration. No adaptive precision or regularization, no iteration parameter tuning. Report matrix sizes, storage and cubic factorization work, and articulation ownership of remaining blocks; these are structural counts, not GPU timing. Do not adopt production code based on this fixture alone.
